page: Microsoft Azure D16nds_v6 is a general-purpose, network-optimized virtual machine provisioned through Microsoft Hyper-V. It is built on an x86_64 Intel processor architecture and allocates 16 dedicated virtual CPU cores paired with 64.0 GB of memory. This yields a standard balanced ratio of 4.0 GB RAM per vCPU, suitable for multi-threaded applications requiring proportional compute and memory allocations without hardware GPU acceleration.

A key feature of the D16nds_v6 instance is its integrated local storage configuration, featuring 944 GB of direct-attached NVMe solid-state storage alongside support for Premium Storage. The bundled NVMe SSD provides low-latency, high-throughput ephemeral scratch space, which avoids external disk network hops for temporary file handling, paging, and localized caching.

In terms of qualitative efficiency, bundling 944 GB of local NVMe storage within a standard 16 vCPU, 64 GB resource profile provides high operational value for I/O-intensive pipelines. The primary tradeoff lies in the ephemeral nature of direct-attached NVMe storage, which requires robust data replication architectures or separate durable managed disks for stateful workloads. Additionally, instances do not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating external networking allocation when internet ingress or egress is required.

Microsoft Azure D16nds_v6 is well-positioned for mid-tier relational database nodes, distributed caches, intermediate extract-transform-load (ETL) processing stages, CI/CD build agents with large build trees, and containerized web application hosting requiring rapid local filesystem operations.
description: Microsoft Azure D16nds_v6 is a general-purpose, network-optimized virtual machine based on x86_64 Intel architecture and virtualized via Microsoft Hyper-V. The server features 16 dedicated vCPUs and 64.0 GB of memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 CPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware configuration includes a bundled 944 GB local NVMe solid-state drive along with Premium Storage capability, offering fast low-latency disk I/O without hardware GPU accelerators. The inclusion of high-speed local NVMe capacity delivers strong architectural efficiency for workloads bound by temporary storage bottlenecks, balanced against the non-persistent nature of local drives. Microsoft Azure D16nds_v6 fits relational databases, enterprise web serving tiers, software build pipelines, and data manipulation workloads that benefit from dedicated compute alongside rapid local scratch storage.
